title.narrative: Media Development

description.narrative: Media Development: These funds will be used to support local media and university-level media/journalism programs with their production and equipment costs. Special attention will be paid to the production of print and broadcast products that emphasize democratic values: political and economic reform, interethnic tolerance and reconciliation, Euro-Atlantic integration, the environment, and a free and independent press (including investigative journalism), among others. Some of these funds will also be directed towards exchange programs, conferences, media organizations, and NGOs that promote Serbias integration into NATO.

title.narrative: Media Development

description.narrative: Media Development: These funds will be used to support local media and university-level media/journalism programs with their production and equipment costs. Special attention will be paid to the production of print and broadcast products that emphasize democratic values: political and economic reform, interethnic tolerance and reconciliation, Euro-Atlantic integration, the environment, and a free and independent press (including investigative journalism), among others. Some of these funds will also be directed towards exchange programs, conferences, media organizations, and NGOs that promote Serbias integration into NATO.

title.narrative: Media Training and Development

description.narrative: Media Training and Development: This funding will be used to support local media and university-level media/journalism programs with their production and equipment costs, and to design and implement media training seminars. Special attention will be paid to the print and broadcast products that emphasize democratic values: political and economic reform, interethnic tolerance and reconciliation, Euro-Atlantic integration, the environment, and a free and independent press (including investigative journalism), among others. Some of these funds will also be directed towards exchange programs, conferences, media organizations, and NGOs that promote increased public interest in and support for Serbias integration into NATO.

title.narrative: Media Training

description.narrative: Media Training: This funding will be used to design and implement media training seminars that will bring U.S. experts to Serbia to train journalists, media managers, editors, publishers, and broadcasters. These funds will also be used to improve training conditions and equipment for journalists and communications students and fund production costs within the framework of a training program. The media in Serbia still require a great degree of development, and programs supported by U.S. assistance will help improve the media environment and develop a professional journalistic ethic in the country.
